text: Several training-free chunking tricks for flow-matching VLAs came out this year, and their numbers come from desktop or data-centre GPUs (RTX 4090, A100, H100, RTX 5090). On these a chunk costs barely tens of milliseconds and spare compute is plentiful. A robot people can buy runs its policy on an edge GPU. There most of the chunk goes to the vision encoder, which these tricks don't affect. We measured how much of each trick is left on such a board.

There most of the chunk goes to the vision encoder, which these tricks don't affect, as Figure 1 shows. We measured how much of each trick is left on such a board.
